correctness.rationale: Chinese-remainder projections classify invariant subspaces; every exterior subalgebra is uniquely a coordinate submodule plus a normalized h-translate modulo that submodule. Mixed closure is invariance of the projected sum; fixing the intersection and the image gives exactly the Gaussian count times the number of graph maps. Two exterior subalgebras permute iff their translations agree off the union of their summands, since there are no invariant lines in the quotient. This is also exactly the commutation condition for the unique nonzero retractions with those images. Gaussian polynomial degrees give dominance for d≥5; for (2,2) the mixed term has degree 6 and exterior pair term degree 4, while G₄² and N² have degree 8 and leading coefficients 1 and 4. The explicit small-case polynomials and 89/169 follow by expansion. An independent bracket-closure census of ALL ambient subspaces, not assuming the exterior classification, checked 2,664 subspaces in the q=3 case and 2,825 in the q=2 case. It found respectively N=312 with ordered counts (44,944; 5,536; 784) and N=419 with (139,876; 4,276; 325) in the zero-, one-, and two-exterior categories.
